claims.experiment: Compared CO flux in 12m+7m cubes (inside a 4 sigma dilated mask) with 12m+7m+TP cube, and flux in CPROPS GMCs
claims.result: ~80-90% of CO flux is extended emission recovered only with total power
claims.finding: The TDG has an extremely high diffuse molecular gas fraction, at the upper end of nearby galaxies

evidence.quote: We find an extremely high fraction of extended molecular emission (${\sim}80{-}90$%), which is filtered out by the ALMA interferometer but recovered by the total power antennas.

claims.hypothesis: Are GMC mass spectra in a pristine TDG similar to those in other galaxies?
claims.experiment: Fitted a truncated power law to the cumulative CPROPS GMC mass distribution (and SCIMES)
claims.result: gamma = -1.76 +/- 0.13 and M0 = 1.9e6 Msun, shallower in the south (-1.30 +/- 0.19)
claims.finding: Mass spectrum is comparable to the Milky Way and nearby galaxies; north-south difference only marginally significant

evidence.quote: GMCs in the TDG follow a mass spectrum that is well described by a truncated power law with slope $\gamma = -1.76 \pm 0.13$ and truncation mass of $M_0 = 1.9 \times 10^6$ $M_\odot$.
The difference is marginally significant given the large error bars

claims.hypothesis: Do GMCs in the TDG obey the Larson scaling relations seen elsewhere?
claims.experiment: Fitted size-linewidth, virial, mass-size relations and Heyer plot with ODR and BayesLineFit
claims.result: Size-linewidth slope 2.00 +/- 0.33 and virial slope 1.66 +/- 0.13 are much steeper than Galactic; mass-size slope 2.08 +/- 0.19 is consistent
claims.finding: Size-linewidth and virial relations are super-linear; virial masses exceed luminous masses by ~1 dex, possibly super-virial clouds or an alpha_CO artifact

evidence.quote: However, the size-linewidth and virial relation in the TDG are super-linear and significantly steeper than observed elsewhere.
This might be an observational artifact, given the large uncertainty in $\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$ in TDGs.

claims.hypothesis: Why is star formation confined to the south of the TDG?
claims.experiment: Compared north and south in gas ratios, velocity dispersions, GMC properties and Kennicutt-Schmidt placement
claims.result: North has higher H2/HI, higher diffuse-gas and cloud-to-cloud velocity dispersion, and similar GMC content
claims.finding: Dynamical effects, not a lack of GMCs, suppress star formation in the north

evidence.quote: Since the main difference between north and south is kinematic, we suggest that clouds in the north are stabilised against collapse by dynamical effects.

claims.hypothesis: Is the CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio abnormal in the TDG?
claims.experiment: Ratio of total power CO(2-1) and IRAM CO(1-0) moment-0 maps at 28 arcsec
claims.result: Mean R21 = 0.52, from ~0.7 in the north to ~0.3 in the south; NGC 3227 average 0.53
claims.finding: R21 is at the lower end of nearby galaxy values, especially in the south, possibly tied to the interaction

evidence.quote: The global CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) ratio is quite low ($R_{21}=0.52$), at the lower end of measurements in nearby galaxies

claims.hypothesis: How are GMCs spatially related to young stellar clusters?
claims.experiment: Overlaid GMCs on HST F547M and H-alpha and measured projected offsets to star-forming knots
claims.result: Offsets range from overlap to >200 pc, increasing with knot age
claims.finding: Star formation proceeds as in other galaxies once triggered; offsets consistent with an age trend

evidence.quote: The smallest offsets ($\lesssim$50 pc) correspond to the youngest star-forming knots, while the largest offsets ($\gtrsim$200 pc) are associated with the oldest knots, consistent with an age trend.

why_this_data.value: Previous molecular gas studies of TDGs lacked the resolution to resolve individual GMCs

evidence.quote: these studies target spatial resolutions that are too coarse to resolve individual giant molecular clouds

why_this_method.value: Constant alpha_CO keeps surface density maps proportional to measured CO(2-1) intensity; CPROPS used to ease comparison with literature

evidence.quote: has the advantage that our surface density maps remain proportional to the directly measured CO(2-1) intensity
We focus on CPROPS to minimise discrepancies with studies from the literature due to different segmentation codes.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Spatially varying alpha_CO modulated by R21 rejected because of the coarse resolution of the R21 map

evidence.quote: We prefer to avoid this modulation of $\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$ by $R_{21}$ because of the coarse resolution ($\sim$28$''$) of the available $R_{21}$ map

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: SCIMES segmentation tried as alternative to CPROPS; results similar

evidence.quote: The results from this section confirm that GMC properties do not look very different when identified with CPROPS or SCIMES.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Non-truncated power law fitted but truncated version preferred

evidence.quote: We fitted both a truncated and non-truncated power law and found that the truncated version applies better to our data.

limitations_admitted.value: Observed projected surface densities may not track volumetric densities

evidence.loc: 5.5 What drives star formation in TDGs?
evidence.quote: the largest limitation is that we are dealing with projected surface densities, and the observed surface densities might not necessarily track the volumetric gas densities

limitations_admitted.value: alpha_CO uncharacterised in TDGs; factor ~10 variation cannot be ruled out

evidence.quote: technically, we cannot rule out a variation of a factor ${\sim}10$ in $\alpha_\mathrm{CO}$

limitations_admitted.value: Smallest clouds may be unresolved and blending is likely for some

evidence.quote: This means that the smallest clouds may be unresolved and blending is likely for some.

referee_caveats_inferred: All GMC masses depend on one assumed alpha_CO and one distance; the 1 dex virial/luminous offset is degenerate with both
Cloud sizes are comparable to the 45 pc beam; extrapolation and deconvolution raise radius errors to ~55%, and size-linewidth slope depends on this
ODR and Bayesian slopes differ substantially for the mass-size relation (2.08 vs 3.25)
Diffuse fraction depends on total power calibration and flux scaling, with no error budget given
North/south GMC counts are inconsistent between sections (62/19 vs 82/29 with 111 total)
Mask of NGC 3227 emission relies on HI-defined regions; contamination from the background galaxy is not quantified

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Order 100-300 GB raw for 18-pointing 12 m mosaic plus 7 m and TP; final cube 1344 x 1440 pixels, 2.5 km/s channels (several GB)
reproducibility.score_reason: Imaging parameters (CASA 5.4.1, Hogbom, natural weighting, pixel and image size) and GMC derivation formulas are given and project code is stated, but calibration details, TP combination steps, CPROPS/SCIMES settings, fit algorithms and the HI cube are not.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA data come from a Cycle 4 project that should be public in the archive, the CPROPS recipe and mass-spectrum/scaling fits are largely described, and the results are numeric; the NGC 3227 mask needs the VLA HI data.
